title: NDP 2026: Rehearsal Night Chaos
description: It's the combined rehearsal and 40,000 people just opened the app at once. The servers are struggling to keep up. You must stabilize things before the show ends.
storyContext: Combined rehearsal. 40,000 people just opened the app at once and everything is going red. Fix it before fireworks, or the committee kills the feature for the real show.

software-engineer.title: Emergency Fix
software-engineer.instruction: The app takes 8 seconds to load and people are giving up. Time for one fix before fireworks. Which one?
software-engineer.hint: A quick fix that works now usually beats a perfect fix that takes too long. What gets the most people back fastest?

options.label: Save recent answers so the app stops asking the system every single time. Fixes 60% of the slowness, but some info may be a few minutes stale.
Turn off the float scanner, show text only. Instant speed boost but the main feature is gone tonight.
Fix the slowest searches at the root. Takes longer but permanently solves the problem.
Add a waiting queue with a loading animation instead of error messages. Nobody gets kicked out, but nobody gets instant results.

data-scientist.title: How Many Machines Do We Need?
data-scientist.instruction: More people join every few minutes. Each machine handles about 5,000 people. The graph shows thousands online at four check-ins. How many machines for the peak?
data-scientist.hint: Project where the crowd tops out, then divide by 5,000. Round up — you can't have half a machine.

cloud-engineer.title: Find What's Broken
cloud-engineer.instruction: Warning screen is lit up. Find what's actually broken and why. Arrange the investigation steps.
cloud-engineer.hint: Start with the big picture before zooming in. Look at what's already visible before digging for hidden clues.

items.label: Pull up the live dashboard — what's under pressure?
Match the spike timing to specific parts of the app
Check error messages from the last 10 minutes for patterns
Follow individual slow requests to see where time is lost
Write up findings so the team can act
